test_Direct_data: test the Direct.data method to set and retrieve configuration, velocity, acceleration, time, sensor, and force data
test_Direct_settings: test the Direct.settings method to get and set configuration length, sensor flag, force flag, and optimization parameters
test_Direct_costs: test the Direct.cost method to compute total, sensor, force, and initial costs with gradients and Hessians
test_Direct_noise: test the Direct.noise method to set and retrieve process, sensor, and parameter noise
test_Direct_reset: test the Direct.reset method to clear all data back to zero values
